name: 01_not_armed_preserves_count
description: Guard: when armed=False, the entire stop-check block is skipped. The inline producer NEITHER increments NOR resets below_stop_count when not armed. Count is preserved unchanged; hit is False.
derivation: armed=False -> the `if armed and not triggered:` guard fails on the FIRST clause. The producer's entire stop-check block (both the magnitude/breakdown condition path AND the reset-else branch) is skipped, so below_stop_count is neither incremented nor reset. Function returns (current_below_stop_count, False) = (2, False). The breakdown-gate direction is irrelevant here (the guard short-circuits the whole block) -- armed=False blocks all of it regardless of prob_underperforming or current_return.
